divergences.name: gpt-image-2-cap-divergence
divergences.subject: GPT Image 2 prompt character cap: the Skill 66 model registry (66-kie-image/models.json, pinned above as skill-66-model-registry) records 25,000 characters with cap status OWNER_CONFIRMED; the shared prompt enforcer's budget table (shared-utils/kie_prompt_enforcer.py, pinned above as kie-prompt-enforcer) records 20,000 for the same model.
divergences.resolution: The owner-confirmed registry value governs (Amendment 6, Part C-rule 5). This skill's references/prompt-budget-policy.json mirrors the registry: gpt-image-2 at 25,000 OWNER_CONFIRMED. GPT Image 2.5's 20,000 figure is NOT owner-confirmed in either source and is carried as NOT_PUBLISHED; overflow against it warns only. If the two sources are reconciled upstream, update prompt-budget-policy.json and this record together. ERRATUM (2026-10-17, S71-06-Q1 ruled): the clause 'overflow against it warns only' is superseded. Under owner Decision 1 (2026-10-15), confirmed by the Q1 ruling to govern in ALL contexts including Signature Launch runs, the rule 12 band applies to every recorded maximum in full: overflow above a recorded maximum fails (budget exit 4), and cap_status (including NOT_PUBLISHED) is provenance only and carries no overflow semantics, as references/prompt-budget-policy.json records in its cap_status_semantics. This erratum changes no cap value and no pin; the GPT Image 2 divergence itself (25,000 registry versus 20,000 enforcer) is unchanged and still routes to the owning rooms (matrix Q4).
